# BookMeThat™ | Travel eSIM, Car Rental & Flight Delay Comparison

> Real-time comparison, direct local partner integrations, and zero broker markups for Travel eSIMs, Local Car Rentals, and Flight Delay Restitution claims.

## Core Services

- **Travel eSIMs** - Compare top cellular data eSIM providers: [Saily](https://saily.tpk.lu/9KzgxKRI), [Airalo](https://airalo.tpk.lu/X5knsFOB), [Yesim](https://yesim.tpk.lu/G4BRVuDa), and [Drimsim](https://drimsim.tpk.lu/Nytg5OEC) across 150+ countries.
- **Car & Scooter Rentals** - Direct local bookings with no credit card deposits via [Localrent](https://localrent.tpk.lu/koWZfRVI) and direct price drop protections via [QEEQ](https://qeeq.tpk.lu/r4v9uF0a).
- **Flight Delay Compensation** - Secure EU261 and US DOT claims for delayed, cancelled, or overbooked flights via [Compensair](https://compensair.tpk.lu/B8KxgKRO) and [AirHelp](https://airhelp.tpk.lu/D4BksFOF).
- **Interactive Nomad Planner** - Custom cost estimator and itinerary planning based on ground logistics and cellular bandwidth requirements.
